steps.title: Define requirements for Nitin Live Wallpaper app
steps.description: Analyze user requirements to build an interactive, animated name live wallpaper showing the name 'नितिन' (Nitin) with custom settings.

steps.title: Generate metadata files and app structure configuration
steps.description: Setup app-meta.json with standard parameters representing the Nitin Live Wallpaper package.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle compatibility parameters
steps.description: Configure compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, AGP 8.3.2, and pure Java 8 target parameters with no external dependencies.

steps.title: Define Hindi-supported local strings
steps.description: Create strings.xml holding appropriate descriptive strings for the application settings and live wallpaper selection lists.

steps.title: Create the Live Wallpaper descriptor config
steps.description: Write xml/wallpaper.xml to let the system interface discover, thumbnail, and describe the customizable service.

steps.title: Develop the NitinWallpaperService base framework
steps.description: Create NitinWallpaperService.java extending standard WallpaperService with state-handling logic for live customization cycles.

steps.title: Implement complex interactive Neon graphic drawing loops
steps.description: Formulate high-performance, double-buffered Canvas operations representing particle generation, customizable gradient cycles, and touch-induced explosion physics.

steps.title: Create MainActivity premium custom dashboard layout
steps.description: Formulate linear layouts inside scrolling panels displaying live customized configurations, neon styled quick pre-visualizer, and wallpaper setting guides.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity controller logic for real-time preferences
steps.description: Code the interactive logic updating shared wallpaper preferences immediately upon text changes or style selects.

steps.title: Incorporate the wallpaper trigger intents
steps.description: Program appropriate native triggers calling ACTION_CHANGE_LIVE_WALLPAPER intents to seamlessly launch the system Live Wallpaper applying interface.

steps.title: Configure system requirements in AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Declare proper BIND_WALLPAPER permissions, manifest entries, launcher activities, and background rendering services inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Building Nitin Live Wallpaper
steps.description: Perform complete SDK 34 compilations generating the fully custom Nitin Live Wallpaper application build.
